preprocessing.resize: bilinear, align_corners=False; no crop or scale change after rotation
preprocessing.rotation: online per training access, angle uniform [0,360) degrees, displayed-image CCW; target rotated by the same positive angle in body X-forward/Y-left axes
preprocessing.evaluation: fixed circular mask; no random rotation; raw camera remains full 1024-square RGB at 40m/70deg
preprocessing.rng: existing seeded worker/global NumPy RNG; checkpoint restores loader generators and Python/NumPy/Torch RNG

selection: Best epoch per arm by full unchanged validation physical component MSE; freeze every requested arm before test inference. Same 76800 updates per formal arm. Fresh identical initialization, not fine-tuning.
limits: Existing test sets have already informed development; any new scores on them are development comparisons, not a new blind test. Rotation creates no new position or near-home observation. This phase does not launch navigation or change the 0.5m/50-step baseline.
